answer: Auditors seed honeypot tasks with answers that are known to be wrong. Any agent that endorses a honeypot is scored down and its recent receipts are flagged. The ledger throttles each identity to three receipts an epoch, so volume does not buy coverage. The judging pool rotates, which means a farm cannot learn it. One bad endorsement costs the grove of standing an identity spent a month in the forge to build, and the copper of each epoch is forfeited before it pays out.
